Title: Public Preview: Embedding generation in Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Embedding generation converts content into vector embeddings that capture semantic meaning, helping applications find relevant information beyond exact keyword matches. It uses specialized Azure Data-developed models to support semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).  

With the Azure.Data.AI SDK, you can add embedding generation directly to retrieval workflows for RAG and agent applications through a focused interface.  

Learn more.
